senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be covered with fat; to be inaccessible, dull, obdurate, stupid (cmp. Lat. pinguis).

units: <cite ref="Berakhot 63b:12">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>מִטַּפְּשִׁים</he> they become dull; <cite ref="Taanit 7a">Taan. 7ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Makkot 10a">Macc. 10ᵃ</cite>

senses.gloss: , part. מְטוּפָּשׁ (denom. of טִפֵּשׁ) decried as a fool, made sport of.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 309">Sifré Deut. 309</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 942">Yalk. ib. 942</cite> (corresp. to <cite ref="N00091"><he>נבל</he></cite> a. <he>לא חכם</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:6">Deut. XXXII, 6</cite>) <he>מנוולים ומְטוּפָּשִׁים</he> disgraced and ridiculed as fools.
